role: elemental texture only — mood beds between archive assets; never a named site, never a depiction
method: Every clip's mid-frame thumbnail was tiled into two contact sheets and looked at. Nothing here was kept on a filename or a search rank. 35 clips acquired across 12 elemental queries; 24 kept, 11 refused.
why_screening_is_not_optional: Pixabay matches loosely over a modern commercial library. Run #1 rejected 12 of 41 texture clips on sight — a gym, money, a tractor, an espresso machine. This pass refused a cat, a lipstick advertisement, buttercups and a tropical pier.

magenta and red particles; two accent colours the palette does not have

an erupting volcano with lightning — the spectacle register the playbook's anti-patterns name
a lava flow; the island's rock is old, and glowing lava is a different claim

shortfall.why: The reuse rule allows each clip once. Seven beats had no clip that honestly reads as what they are for — fog over dark ground, a raking light across basalt, rain on stone after the one rain clip is spent — so they are authored as texture_field configurations instead, which is what the playbook asks for when the clip bank runs out. Each authored instance has its own kind, seed, density and angle, so no two are the same configuration.
